name: cambodian_silk_archives
description: Collection: My archive will digitally document the biological lifecycle, traditional harvesting processes, and unique environmental factors that produce Cambodia's rare, naturally golden raw silk (Tromol Meas). Source: The physical samples, tools, and sericulture knowledge will be sourced directly from veteran silkworm farmers and mulberry cultivators on Koh Oknha Tei and Koh Dach.
